BiblicalUsage: Helkai is named once, as the head of the priestly house of Meraioth in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua. He is one name in the list of the priests who return and serve.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the priests are counted house by house, and Helkai's house is one of them. The return is recorded in names, not only in numbers.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
